title: The Last Ferry
logline: On the harbour quay at dusk, Captain Gwenllian Price tells the late passengers the last ferry is leaving.

brief.text: On the harbour quay at dusk, Captain Gwenllian Price tells the late passengers the last ferry is leaving.

scenes.title: Last call

beats.action: On the quay the captain turns to the late passengers, off-screen, and calls them aboard.

scenes.purpose: The captain calls the last passengers aboard.

shots.purpose: The captain calls the passengers aboard
shots.action: Medium shot of the captain standing on the quay in front of her ferry, facing the camera; she calls her line clearly to the passengers off-screen beside the camera.

dialogue.text: Bags aboard, please! The last boat to Bardsey leaves before the tide turns.
